# gtme help

Print this document.

## Forms

```
gtme help --agent
gtme help --bindings
```

| Form | Does |
|---|---|
| `gtme help --agent` | print this document |
| `gtme help --bindings` | print the binding contract — schema, discovery path, a reference binding, the fixtures expectation — for authoring an adapter this binary does not ship (see `bindings` below) |

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | Form | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent` | nothing | `gtme help --agent` | See the form. |
| `--bindings` | nothing | `gtme help --bindings` | See the form. |

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

From [Add a vendor](/start/add-a-vendor):

```sh
gtme help --bindings > bindings.json
```

## Used in

- [For agents](/start/for-agents): The help verb, including the --agent output the agent reads
